newsitem.title: USA: U.S. rice weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. rice weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA rice export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales of 25,600 MT were 73 percent below the prior week and 59 percent under the 4-week average. The major buyers were Mexico (9,500 MT, of which 9,100 MT was rough), Guatemala (8,500 MT--all rough), Nicaragua (5,400 MT, of which 3,600 MT was rough), and the Netherlands (4,300 MT).
In addition, there were rough rice sales to Turkey (600 MT). Reductions of 7,000 MT were reported for the Leeward and Windward Islands.

Exports of 84,200 MT were up three-quarters from the prior week and three-fifths from the 4-week average. The primary destinations were Mexico (23,500 MT), Turkey (21,900 MT), Japan (10,600 MT), Nicaragua (5,400 MT), and Haiti (5,000 MT).
